_comment: FAKE brand for tests and as a starting template. Not a real business: every domain uses the reserved .example TLD, which never resolves. Copy this file for a real client, fill it in, and upload it to Render as a Secret File — never commit a client's file (see docs/CLIENT_SETUP.md).

allowed_links._comment: Your own website_domain, instagram_handle and email are always allowed in replies. List only OTHER domains / Instagram handles / emails Twin may mention.

messages.lead_reply: Thanks for trying our assistant! The Example Candle team will message you personally.
messages.allergy_holding_line: The Example Candle team will look into this and get back to you shortly.
messages.escalate_fallback_holding_reply: Thanks for telling us — I'm passing this to the Example Candle team, who'll reach out to you personally within a few hours.
messages.instagram_photo_reply: I can't view photos here yet — tell me the scent or room you're shopping for and I'll suggest one!
messages.shipped_intro: Hi {first_name}! Your Example Candle Co order #{order_number} is on its way
messages.out_for_delivery: Hi {first_name}! Your Example Candle Co order #{order_number} is out for delivery today.
messages.delivered: Hi {first_name}! Your order #{order_number} has been delivered. Enjoy your candles!

rag._comment: trigger_terms: product words that make Twin look up product/policy facts before replying (shipping, refund, cancel and other policy words are built in for every brand). Each is a regex fragment matched as a whole word, case-insensitive: 'candle(s)?' = candle or candles. named_products: when a customer names a product, lookups use only that product's facts — 'product' is part of its Shopify handle, 'terms' the phrases that name it.

_storage_prefix: Names this copy's files: <prefix>_logs.db (temp-folder DB and the default GITHUB_BACKUP_PATH), <prefix>_seen_ids.txt. Give every brand its own, so brands sharing one backup repo never overwrite each other.
